verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships as a terminal TUI, IDE extension, and desktop app, explicitly documented to integrate with VS Code, Cursor, or any terminal-capable IDE via a keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+Esc) to open a split terminal chat view with file-reference insertion, and community users confirm using it as their daily coding harness inside editors. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically praising IDE-embedded chat UX (most community commentary focuses on TUI/model behavior rather than IDE-extension experience) and no visual/UX detail beyond docs.
